Column.name: Notes
Column.value: This figure shows how a classification data set can include associated metadata, together with a discrete coverage. Column.name: Name
Column.value: Fig 05 Elements of a Discrete Coverage

Column.name: Notes
Column.value: This figure shows how a discrete coverage as used in this document is a CoverageByDomainAndRange where a classified range is restricted to discrete values. The allowable values for a classified domain are described by the classification system legend. The discrete coverage returns the same record of feature attribute values for any direct position within a single Domain Object in its domain. Each geometry value pair consists of a domain object (e.g. a grid cell or a polygon) and a record of feature attribute values.

Column.name: Notes
Column.value: This figure shows the relationship of a coverage to a feature type as described in the general feature model. It also illustrates the how the Coverage ValueSet has one or more Records as their value, and how the domain values relate to DirectPositions that are spatially located with respect to a Coordinate Reference System (CRS).
